question: If our CISO role changed hands, what would we need to revisit?
answer:
If the CISO role (or the CIP Senior Manager role) changes hands, there are two primary areas you must revisit: the formal regulatory identification of the manager and the internal documentation of their authority.

### 1. Regulatory Notification (CIP-003-9 R3)
Under **CIP-003-9 R3**, the Responsible Entity is required to identify the CIP Senior Manager by name and **document any change within 30 calendar days of the change** [csection-ec9dfcc4f8695e265184]. 

*Note: While the search results also show a retired version of this requirement (CIP-003-8 R3) with the same 30-day mandate, the current effective requirement (CIP-003-9) maintains this specific deadline [csection-ec9dfcc4f8695e265184].*

### 2. Internal Documentation and Delegations
While the standard allows existing delegations to remain in effect even if the delegator (the Senior Manager) is replaced, you must still update your internal records to reflect the new individual's authority [csection-3d98554d1cb48f6334c4].

*   **Update Senior Manager Records:** You must ensure that all documentation identifying the CIP Senior Manager is updated to reflect the new person [csection-3d98554d1cb48f6334c4].
*   **Verify Delegations:** Although the standard states that "delegations do not have to be re-instated if the individual who delegated the task changes roles," you should review your delegation logs to ensure the new CISO/Senior Manager is aware of the existing authorities granted to others [csection-3d98554d1cb48f6334c4].

### Summary of Actions
| Task | Deadline/Condition | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Identify new Manager by name** | Within 30 calendar days of change | [csection-ec9dfcc4f8695e265184] |
| **Update documentation of Senior Manager** | To prevent undocumented authority | [csection-3d98554d1cb440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3] |
| **Review existing delegations** | Existing delegations remain valid | [csection-3d98554d1cb440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3] |

I have not reviewed your specific internal "Roles and Responsibilities" document to see if it contains additional, stricter notification timelines or specific internal workflows for CISO transitions. I can review that if you provide the relevant section.
